---
name: Method or experiment proposal
about: Discuss a method, protocol, metric, or substantial experiment before implementation.
title: "[Proposal] "
assignees: ""
---

## Problem and motivation

What limitation or research question would this address?

## Proposed change

Describe the method, protocol, or experiment and its assumptions.

## Evidence and evaluation plan

What existing evidence supports the proposal? Which baselines, cases, metrics, and tests would evaluate it?

## Cost and risks

Estimate data, compute, implementation, and compatibility costs. Note any effect on frozen defaults or existing claims.

## Scope decision

Please wait for maintainer agreement on scope before starting a large implementation or experiment.
